question:
I want to travel to London soon and I bought a mobile application product developed by a world-leading sightseeing pass company that allows holders to skip the line and visit dozens of historical and cultural sites in the UK capital, including a fortress built by the Norman conquerors and an abbey where sacred ceremonies for monarchs have been held throughout history. Please help me find out which museums this application currently provides free access to as of 2025. I need the museum, last entry time on weekends, normal ticket price for one adult, and its specific address. I have no interest in sports so just skip the relevant museums.

Please present the information in one Markdown table with these column headers: Museum, Last Entry Time, Ticket Price (Pounds), and Address. Format the "Last Entry Time" like "4:00 pm".

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
